label: LoRA Lab: Vehicle Icons
description: Subject LoRAs that put one specific machine in the frame — three of them the pack author's own (mastermerlin). The trigger word is woven into the item text verbatim, because dropping it silently kills the LoRA; data carries the exact filename, strength and Civitai AIR urn. Tagged by base-model family: a flux1 car in an SDXL render is the classic wasted seed.

items.name: ferrari-f40-1987
items.text: FerrariF40, the 1987 Ferrari F40 in its original homologation shape, NACA ducts and that upright rear wing

lora_info.name: Ferrari F40 - 1987
lora_info.creator: mastermerlin
lora_info.about: Reproduces the 1987 F40's exact proportions and panel breaks rather than a generic wedge supercar; mastermerlin's top-rated model at 1,108 downloads and 75 thumbs-up, with the Flux.1 D version the most-downloaded of its thirteen base variants.

items.name: shelby-cobra-427-1965
items.text: ShelbyCobra427, the 1965 Shelby Cobra 427 on its stubby big-block proportions, side pipes and blistered arches

lora_info.name: Shelby Cobra 427 - 1965
lora_info.creator: mastermerlin
lora_info.about: Holds the 427 Cobra's short wheelbase and hand-formed aluminium surfacing, which generic car models flatten into a modern roadster; 908 downloads and 58 thumbs-up, the Flux.1 D version tied as its most-downloaded.

items.name: porsche-911-targa-1989
items.text: 911-930T4rga, the 1989 Porsche 911 Turbo Targa on the wide 930 body, removable roof panel and whale-tail

lora_info.name: Porsche 911 Turbo Targa (930) - 1989
lora_info.creator: mastermerlin
lora_info.about: The 930 Turbo Targa's specific roof-hoop and wide-arch geometry, a shape most base models collapse into a generic 911; 986 downloads and 61 thumbs-up, with the Qwen version its most-downloaded release.

items.name: widebody-sports-car-xl
items.text: a widebody sports car, arches flared out hard over the extra track width, stance sitting square on the road

lora_info.name: Widebody Cars [SDXL]
lora_info.creator: fallenL
lora_info.about: A tuning-style LoRA that widens body work across six trained class words (widebody sports car, super car, hatchback, sedan, suv, truck), recommended at 0.6-1.0 weight; 4,001 downloads and 301 thumbs-up.

items.name: nissan-skyline-r34
items.text: skyliner34, car, vehicle, the R34-generation Nissan Skyline GT-R with its squared-off arches and quad tail lamps

lora_info.name: NISSAN Skyline GT-R R34 car LORA
lora_info.creator: Mikoeiaow
lora_info.about: Pins the R34 GT-R's specific greenhouse and rear-quarter shape instead of a generic 90s coupe; the most-downloaded single-car LoRA in Civitai's car-photography results at 5,486 downloads and 619 thumbs-up.
